title: Black Fish Tavern Water Ride
content: The rapids ride takes you churning past a half-sunk submersible and sunken galleons. Then you drop down into a hidden entry into The World Beneath. At the far end you rise into light and visit the golden realm of Waterfall City. Singers serenade you right before you float into the firing line of the water cannon.Then spend some time at the Black Fish Tavern, where you can interact with dinosaurs, joke with pirates, or check out the burlesque dancers and outrageous jazz bands entertain you while you tuck into a platter of comfort food from the deep blue sea.
